nodes.label: CarPlay
nodes.rationale: In-vehicle interface system bringing essential iPhone features (navigation, audio, messaging, calling) safely to car displays.

nodes.label: Driver Safety and Glanceable Layout
nodes.rationale: Minimize distraction by eliminating iPhone interactions while driving, placing primary content high onscreen, and using high-contrast layouts.

nodes.label: CarPlay Audio Session Management
nodes.rationale: Respect vehicle audio ecosystems; delay session initialization until ready to avoid cutting off the car radio, and resume only from temporary interruptions.
